evidence.label: FCA Safety Recall S08 / NHTSA 16V-273 - Power Steering Return Hose and Fluid Cooler

trims: Block-heater-equipped vehicles included in recall S08; verify engine, build date, and VIN
after.title: Power-Steering Return Hose Can Rupture After Extreme Cold (Recall 16V-273)
after.description: FCA recall S08/NHTSA 16V-273 covers certain 2009-2016 Dodge Journey vehicles equipped with an engine block heater. After extended exposure to extreme cold, a return hose or cooler line can rupture at engine start, leak fluid, and cause loss of power-steering assist.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall S08/16V-273. FCA's remedy replaces the applicable power-steering return hoses, steel tubes, and oil cooler. Steering remains mechanically connected, but extra effort can be required, especially at low speed.
symptoms: Power-steering fluid leak after a cold start
Steering effort increases after loss of assist

citations.title: FCA Safety Recall S08 / NHTSA 16V-273 - Power Steering Return Hose and Fluid Cooler

after.contentUpdateSummary: Retained the steering-hose recall with its exact block-heater/cold-weather boundary, loss-of-assist consequence, warning symptoms, and multi-line/cooler remedy.
